integrity: All formulas follow from two affine row types, exhaustive independent exact-integer local determinant checks, and a quotient-lifting proof; no publication or external independent certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the Sylvester Walsh family and five-by-five minors for binary dimension d>=4; the previously tabulated d=4 counts and the maximum ±1 determinant 48 are not new. The classification in all dimensions relies on exact finite local enumeration and an analytic lift; broader priority and independent validation remain open.
title: Five-point Walsh sampling has an exact all-dimensional determinant distribution
